text_block_list.text: During a training session at the camp—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uhyahaha!!
That tickles so muuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew~ Thanks for the massage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It used to hurt a little before, but now I'm fine!
In fact, it kind of tickles!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, it seemed like she might not be able to run the Kikuka Sho,
so this is a big relief.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"This is all thanks to everything
you've done for me, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Let's give the Kikuka Sho our all too, okay?
Let's do our best at the Kikuka Sho as well!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, to show my gratitude to Trainer,
I absolutely have to win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, well, I actually came up with some training
that puts less strain on the legs. Will you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We promised to do our best together,
so I wondered if there was anything I could do too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, first up is "water volleyball"!
Since it's in the water, it won't put as much strain on your legs!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Second is "free diving"!
If we're lucky, maybe we'll find some sea urchins!
choice_data_list: Both kind of feel like playing around...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I figured having fun would be way better anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Besides, even if it's just playing, you're using your whole body to move around, so it doubles as training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How about it, want to give it a try?
choice_data_list: Well then, how about we play water volleyball?
How about we try free-diving, then?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! We did it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer, go change into your swimwear too.
I'll go grab the ball!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, obviously.
It's not like you can play water volleyball alone.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that you get it, go get changed, get changed!
'Cause I'm not holding back at all~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on~! If you don't move with more *whoosh*,
you won't catch the ball~!

It certainly trains the body—
it was hard enough play to genuinely make you think so.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! We did it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'm heading out right away!
Look forward to your souvenirs!

A little while after Tokai Teio
went skin-diving—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer!
There were so many sea cucumbers!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I caught every last one of 'em, so eat up and enjoy!

Looking behind Tokai Teio,
there was a massive mountain of sea cucumbers.

"While praising the guts it took to catch this much,
I apologized, saying, 'There's really no way we can eat all this.'"
